creator: Alexander Terp
description: Seen in the overnight freeze: the core's stall watch (bridge.stalled every 3 deadlines, 15 s) counted 9 restarts in 2 minutes that the shell, running minutes behind, never acted on, and under load it replaces bridges that were only slow to spawn (5.6-21 s measured against a 15 s premise). After the freeze fix it cannot hang a window, only waste bridges. The fix is the shell reporting when it starts a bridge, with the watch timing from that report: a proto request and a change to typeable and respawn.
title: The stall watch replaces bridges the shell never started
